text: It is but natural that a new book by such a world-famous man as Mr. Carnegie should receive a good deal of attention, but it is not the Author's reputation alone which is responsible for the continuous popularity of ‘The Empire of Business.’ The book is appreciated for its heartening influence, and for the sane and kindly advice it imparts.
The new popular edition can be obtained at Booksellers', or of the Publishers.
Bound in cloth extra, with photogravure portrait. 333 pages.
